name: surex-vendored-walrus-wasm
comment: Marks this directory as CommonJS. wasm-bindgen's nodejs glue is CJS and locates the .wasm with __dirname; without this file it inherits type:module from the package root, __dirname does not exist, and the wasm is looked for relative to the process cwd instead.
